title: Mango Sticky Rice
paragraphs: Mango sticky rice (khao niew mamuang) pairs sweet coconut-glazed sticky rice with ripe mango and a drizzle of salted coconut cream. It’s a balance of sweet, salty, and creamy.
The sticky rice is made from glutinous rice, steamed and mixed with coconut milk and sugar. This dessert shines during mango season when fruit is at its peak.
